title: 第10章 ?新术
content_zh:
第10章新术
赵清菡身材高挑，今夜穿了一袭束腰不过膝的白裙，将美好身材展露无疑，曲线起伏，双腿修长。
夜风吹来，扬起她一绺乌黑光滑的长发，莹白瓜子脸很美，原本清秀甜美，带着微笑，但现在……却笑容凝滞。
现场安静，所有人都未动。
赵清菡一身白裙，连她这种见惯场面、情商很高的女子都陷入刹那的寂静，可想而知，气氛多么异常。
王煊转身，正好与对她对面而立。
山上枫树火红，景色秀丽，山下城市灯火灿烂，这些像是一幅画卷的背景，将现场的人衬托出一种宁静的美。
王煊真的没有想到，赵清菡会突然出现。
最主要的还是秦诚乱插话，导致画风突变。
“你来晚了，自罚一杯。”王煊开口。
谁都没有想到，他会这么镇定，一点都不带迟疑的，举起手中的酒杯，对身前的赵清菡微笑致意。
赵清菡平日虽然从容自信，经常出席各种活动，见过大场面，但刚才身体确实略微有些发僵。
现在下意识就要举起手中的红酒杯，但很快她又冷静下来。
举杯到一半后，她脸上重新漾起笑容，恢复灿烂，但却没有说话，也没有去与王煊碰杯，想看他的表现，还能有什么迅速与机敏的反应。
这时，秦诚开口说话：“清菡，你别误会，老王他人很靠谱，刚才主要是我说话太急了！”
原本淡定的王煊不淡定了，很想说，兄弟，你会不会说话，怎么又插话了？！
这种事最好的处理方式就是尽快揭过去，没什么好解释的，所以王煊刚才面不改色，就像是什么都没发生过一样。
赵清菡也无言，举起手中的酒杯与王煊轻碰，浅浅的润了润红唇，转身离去，留下一个优雅的背影。
“我说错什么了吗？”秦诚问道，他自己也知道画蛇添足，越描越黑了。
王煊拍了怕他的肩头，道：“你说的没错，这不，直接将她给支走了，大家都不尴尬。”

秦诚吐着酒气道：“不是，我的本意是想和她单独说两句，喝一杯，结果人都走了，我找谁去。”
“直接就过去呗，她现在又没离开。”孔毅给他支招。
然后，他将王煊拉走，来到山顶边缘区域，凭栏眺望远处大地上的灯火。
“这次有人帮你说话，想将你带到新星。”孔毅双手放在栏杆上，说出这样一句话。
王煊已经知道，林教授曾找过投资方。
但是，他觉得孔毅应该不只是要告诉他这些，不禁侧头看向他。
“旧术研究这个项目的负责人对你有印象，虽然你的状况与选拔条件不符，但你在旧术上的表现有些惊人，所以想破例带走你。”
果然，当中有隐情，孔毅单独找他有话要说。
“凌薇的家人干预了，要将你压制在旧土，不让你去新星。”
这些话像惊雷般响在王煊的耳畔，让他瞬间酒醒，目光顿时无比犀利，盯着孔毅。
孔毅一向强势，毫不示弱，转过身来与他对视，道：“你不信的话可以找人去查，总会有蛛丝马迹留下，况且这件事儿既然我知，也一定还有其他人了解。”
“为什么告诉我这些？”王煊问道。
孔毅沉声道：“我怕你得到一鳞半爪的消息，知道有人压制你，最后会错怪在我头上，这口黑锅我不背！”
他转身离去前低声补充：“凌薇家里远比你想象的有力量，有影响力！”
看着他的背影出现在别墅灯火处，王煊依旧站在原地，转身再次眺望山下的璀璨城市。
“是我将人想的太好了吗？”他轻语。
早先，秦诚就曾怀疑，是不是他前女友家里出力了，要将他压制在旧土，当时他还摇头，认为不至于。
王煊接触过凌薇的父亲，确切的说，是那个中年人主动找到过他，给他施压。
第一次见面时，凌启明虽然很严肃，但是他也有另一面，脸上写满一个父亲对女儿的担忧与关爱，怕她选错人。
当时，王煊被对方审视，凌启明言语很冲的质问他，但他并没有生气。

将心比心，如果他有个女儿在异星有了男友，王煊觉得自己也会有些担心，会杀过去看一看。
凌启明的气场实在太强，到后来确实让王煊有些受不了，被一而再的警告。
不过那个时候，无论凌启明气场多么强，也没有私下动用关系针对他，这让王煊对他印象不算坏。
王煊一向不愿以恶意来揣度别人，总会设身处地的换位思考，认为这是一个强势父亲对女儿的保护，虽然过分了，但也勉强可以理解。
直到现在，他觉得自己将一些人与事想的过于美好了。
他摇了摇头，吐了一口浊气，向回走去，对于已经发生的事，他不愿再去纠结，人始终要向前看。
“王煊，这边来！”周坤喊他过去喝酒。
王煊顿时眼神异样，他很清楚，周坤一旦饮酒，那就会放飞自我，像是换了个人般，嘴里会说个没完。
周坤不在乎，道：“我去找你时不是说了吗，今晚要与你喝个痛快，好好聊一聊。”
不远处，苏婵、徐文博等人眼皮微跳，周坤这是主动要去泄密啊，他一喝醉，那就成话唠了，有问必答。
“他故意的吧？”李清竹小声道。
苏婵撇嘴，道：“随他吧，新术也不是什么秘密了，过段时间肯定会传到旧土。”
王煊明白，周坤借着醉酒，主动要告知他一些情况。
这时，秦诚凑了过来，满脸喜滋滋：“我刚才和女神单独喝了一杯，她说有时间以后到月亮上去看我，对了，刚才她还问起老王你，旧术到底练到什么层次了，我告诉她，约等于九点八个孔毅，十二点五个周坤，十一点六个徐文博。”
周坤原本还准备醉酒呢，一听这话顿时不干了，道：“秦诚，有你这么比较的吗？”
孔毅也走了过来，神色不善，道：“你会不会说话？！”
即便是高冷的徐文博也绷不住了，嘴角抽搐了两下，道：“秦诚，有你这么衡量的吗，我都成计量单位了？”
“我那只是随口一说，喝酒，大男人都计较什么？”秦诚一把拉住周坤，道：“我最喜欢和你喝酒了，来，咱俩走一杯！”
周坤斜睨他，秦诚这绝对是冲着灌醉他套秘密而来，还不清楚他其实要主动对王煊“泄密”。
王煊赶紧拦住秦诚，怕他真将周坤灌醉倒地，道：“慢点喝。”

秦诚诧异，周坤喝下半杯酒后就渐渐开始放飞自我了。
“我告诉你们，新星那边出现了新术，也叫超术，更有人希望称之为神术……”
“周坤，你胆子不小，随便就在外面乱说话，有些事现在还处在保密阶段，你这样做好吗？”
突兀的话语传来，有人在大步接近。
这是一个青年男子，留着短发，身体健硕，能有一百八十五公分，眼睛非常亮，犀利的刺人。
“云哥，我喝醉了，下次注意。”周坤酒醒，但并不紧张，显然认识这个男子。
来人比周坤、徐文博等人要大上几岁，小麦肤色带着光泽，他很强势，言语不委婉，盯着王煊与秦诚，道：你们也真敢，套话呢？想灌醉周坤，从他这里知道一些事？”
周坤立刻拦住他，道：“云哥，这是我们同学间的聚会，你如果想喝酒，去房间！”
孔毅、徐文博等人也立刻走过来，挡住他的去路，劝他不要这样。
“你谁啊，说话这么冲，吃枪药了吗？！”秦诚一点也不惯着他，直接质问。
看到苏婵、李清竹等人也走了过来，云哥顿时笑了，道：“你们紧张什么，我是那么不讲理的人吗？”
赵清菡走来，道：“云哥，我知道你为什么出现在这里，不要这样好不好？”
云哥笑了笑，道：“我今天不是惹事儿来的，嗯，就是听说这里有人旧术练的不错，想切磋下。”
“王煊，你不是对新术很好奇吗，来，和我切磋，我给你演示！”被称作云哥的人竟说出这样一番话。
一时间，不要说旧土的同学，就是来自新星的同窗也都心惊，他竟然……练成新术？！
王煊很平静，他早已注意到，这个人是乘坐一艘小型飞艇上来的，停在两架飞碟不远处那块稍小的空地上。
他一出现，就直接朝这边走来。
王煊意识到，这个人就是冲他而来的，因为其目光曾多次落在他身上，不断扫视与观察。
现在，这个青年更是直接点了他的名字。
“简单的切磋，敢不敢来一场，旧术对新术，你有信心吗？”被称呼为云哥的青年再次问道。

王煊看着他的面孔，若有所思。
若是在往日，有人莫名向他邀战，王煊多半会无视，懒得理会。
但是，眼下这个青年让他意动，竟已经掌握所谓的新术，他很想看一看那到底是怎样的一条路！
“新术，也被称为超术，还有人更愿意称它为神术。”
很强势的男子在那里自顾说道，接着又补充：“旧术，在新星几乎要正式淘汰了，现在有人开始称呼它为陋术。”
他冲王煊招手，道：“你想证明一下吗，看一看旧术还能否焕发出新的光彩。”
content_en:
Chapter 10 New Technique
Zhao Qinghan has a tall figure. Tonight, she wore a white skirt that tied her waist to no more than her knees, showing off her beautiful figure, with undulating curves and slender legs.
The night wind blew up, lifting up a lock of her long black and smooth hair. Her fair face was beautiful. She was originally delicate and sweet, with a smile, but now... her smile was stagnant.
The scene was quiet and no one moved.
Zhao Qinghan was wearing a white dress. Even a woman like her who was used to seeing things and had a high emotional intelligence fell into a moment of silence. One can imagine how unusual the atmosphere was.
Wang Xuan turned around and stood opposite her.
The maple trees on the mountain are flaming red, the scenery is beautiful, and the city lights below the mountain are bright. These are like the background of a painting, bringing out a peaceful beauty to the people at the scene.
Wang Xuan really didn't expect that Zhao Qinghan would suddenly appear.
The most important thing is that Qin Cheng interrupted randomly, which caused a sudden change in the painting style.
"You're late, punish yourself with a drink." Wang Xuan said.
No one expected that he would be so calm, without hesitation at all, raising the wine glass in his hand and smiling at Zhao Qinghan in front of him.
Although Zhao Qinghan is usually calm and confident, often attending various events and seeing big scenes, his body was indeed slightly stiff just now.
Now she subconsciously wanted to raise the red wine glass in her hand, but she soon calmed down again.
Halfway through the toast, a smile appeared on her face again, and it was bright again, but she did not speak, nor did she clink glasses with Wang Xuan, hoping to see his performance and his quick and alert reaction.
At this time, Qin Cheng spoke: "Qinghan, don't get me wrong, Lao Wang is very reliable. It was mainly because I spoke too hastily!"
Wang Xuan, who was originally calm, was no longer calm. He wanted to say, brother, can you speak? Why did you interrupt again? !
The best way to deal with this kind of thing is to expose it as soon as possible. There is nothing to explain, so Wang Xuan's expression didn't change just now, as if nothing happened.
Zhao Qinghan was speechless. He raised the wine glass in his hand and touched it lightly with Wang Xuan. He lightly moistened his red lips and turned away, leaving an elegant back.
"Did I say something wrong?" Qin Cheng asked. He also knew that he was adding more color to the matter and making it darker and darker.
Wang Xuan patted him on the shoulder and said: "You are right, no, just send her away directly so that no one will be embarrassed."
Qin Cheng breathed out his alcohol and said, "No, my original intention was to have a few words with her alone and have a drink, but everyone left. Who should I go to?"
"Just go over there, she hasn't left yet." Kong Yi gave him advice.
Then, he pulled Wang Xuan away and came to the edge of the mountain top, leaning on the railing and looking at the lights on the ground in the distance.
"This time someone is speaking for you and wants to bring you to Xinxing." Kong Yi put his hands on the railing and said this.
Wang Xuan already knew that Professor Lin had been looking for investors.
However, he felt that Kong Yi should not just tell him this, so he couldn't help but look sideways at him.
"The person in charge of the old art research project is impressed by you. Although your situation does not meet the selection conditions, your performance in old art is somewhat amazing, so I want to make an exception and take you away."
Sure enough, there was something hidden, and Kong Yi came to him alone to have something to say.
"Ling Wei's family intervened and wanted to suppress you in the old land and prevent you from going to Xinxing."
These words rang in Wang Xuan's ears like thunder, making him sober in an instant, and his eyes suddenly became extremely sharp, staring at Kong Yi.
Kong Yi was always strong and showed no weakness. He turned around and looked at him and said, "If you don't believe it, you can ask someone to investigate. There will always be clues left. Besides, since I know about this matter, there must be other people who know about it."
"Why are you telling me this?" Wang Xuan asked.
Kong Yi said in a deep voice: "I'm afraid that if you get some information and know that someone is suppressing you, you will end up wrongly blaming me. I won't take the blame for this!"
Before he turned and left, he added in a low voice: "Ling Wei's family is far more powerful and influential than you think!"Seeing his back appear in the light of the villa, Wang Xuan still stood where he was, turning around and looking at the bright city under the mountain again.
"Am I thinking too well of others?" he whispered.
Earlier, Qin Cheng had wondered whether his ex-girlfriend's family was trying to suppress him in the old land. At that time, he shook his head and thought it was not possible.
Wang Xuan had contact with Ling Wei's father. To be precise, it was the middle-aged man who took the initiative to find him and put pressure on him.
Although Ling Qiming was serious when they first met, he also had another side. His face was full of a father's worry and care for his daughter, fearing that she would choose the wrong person.
At that time, Wang Xuan was scrutinized by the other party, and Ling Qiming questioned him harshly, but he was not angry.
Comparing his feelings, if one of his daughters had a boyfriend on another planet, Wang Xuan felt that he would be a little worried and would go over and have a look.
Ling Qiming's aura was so strong that Wang Xuan couldn't stand it and was warned again and again.
But at that time, no matter how strong Ling Qiming's aura was, he did not use his connections to target him in private, which made Wang Xuan not have a bad impression of him.
Wang Xuan has always been unwilling to judge others with malice. He always puts himself in their shoes and thinks that this is a strong father's protection of his daughter. Although it is excessive, it is still understandable.
Until now, he felt that he thought some people and things were too good.
He shook his head, exhaled a breath, and walked back. He didn't want to dwell on what had happened. People should always look forward.
"Wang Xuan, come over here!" Zhou Kun called him over to drink.
Wang Xuan's eyes suddenly looked strange. He knew very well that once Zhou Kun drank, he would let himself go, as if he was a different person, and he would talk endlessly.
Zhou Kun didn't care and said, "Didn't I tell you when I went to find you that I wanted to have a drink and have a good chat with you tonight?"
Not far away, the eyelids of Su Chan, Xu Wenbo and others twitched slightly. Zhou Kun was taking the initiative to leak the secret. When he was drunk, he became a chatterbox and answered every question.
"Did he do it on purpose?" Li Qingzhu whispered.
Su Chan curled her lips and said, "Let it go. The new technique is no longer a secret. It will definitely spread to the old land after a while."
Wang Xuan understood that Zhou Kun took the initiative to inform him of some situations while drunk.
At this time, Qin Cheng came over, his face full of joy: "I just had a drink with the goddess alone. She said she would come to see me on the moon when she has time. By the way, just now she asked Lao Wang how far you have practiced the old skills. I told her that it is about nine point eight Kong Yi, twelve point five Zhou Kun, and eleven point six Xu Wenbo."
Zhou Kun was originally planning to get drunk, but when he heard this, he immediately stopped and said, "Qin Cheng, is there anyone who compares like you?"
Kong Yi also came over, with a bad look on his face, and said, "Can you speak?!"
Even the aloof Xu Wenbo couldn't hold back anymore. The corner of his mouth twitched twice and said: "Qin Cheng, do you have such a measure? I have become a unit of measurement?"
"I just said casually, what do grown men care about drinking?" Qin Cheng grabbed Zhou Kun and said, "I like drinking with you the most. Come on, let's have a drink!"
Zhou Kun glanced at him sideways. Qin Cheng was definitely here to get him drunk and keep secrets. It was not clear that he actually wanted to take the initiative to "leak secrets" to Wang Xuan.
Wang Xuan quickly stopped Qin Cheng, fearing that he would really make Zhou Kun drunk and fall to the ground, and said: "Drink slowly."
Qin Cheng was surprised. Zhou Kun gradually started to let himself go after drinking half a glass of wine.
"Let me tell you, there is a new art over Xinxing, also called super art, and some people want to call it divine art..."
"Zhou Kun, you are very courageous. You talk nonsense outside casually. Some things are still confidential. Can you do this?"
Sudden words were heard, and someone was approaching in large strides.
This is a young man with short hair, a strong body, about 185 centimeters tall, and very bright, sharp eyes."Brother Yun, I'm drunk, please be careful next time." Zhou Kun was sober but not nervous. He obviously knew this man.
The person who came here was a few years older than Zhou Kun, Xu Wenbo and others, with a shiny complexion. He was very strong and his words were not tactful. He stared at Wang Xuan and Qin Cheng and said: You are really brave. Where are the clichés? Want to get Zhou Kun drunk and learn something from him? "
Zhou Kun immediately stopped him and said, "Brother Yun, this is a party between our classmates. If you want to drink, go to your room! "
Kong Yi, Xu Wenbo and others also came over immediately, blocked his way, and advised him not to do this.
"Who are you? You speak so rudely, have you taken any medicine? ! "Qin Cheng didn't tolerate him at all and asked directly.
Seeing Su Chan, Li Qingzhu and others coming over, Brother Yun immediately smiled and said, "Why are you so nervous? Am I such an unreasonable person? "
Zhao Qinghan came over and said: "Brother Yun, I know why you are here, please don't do this, okay? "
Brother Yun smiled and said: "I'm not here to cause trouble today. Well, I just heard that there are people here who are good at practicing old skills and want to learn from each other. "
"Wang Xuan, aren't you very curious about new techniques? Come, compete with me, and I will demonstrate to you! "The man called Brother Yun actually said such words.
For a moment, not to mention the old classmates, even the classmates from Xinxing were shocked. He actually... practiced a new technique? !
Wang Xuan was very calm. He had already noticed that this person came up in a small airship and stopped in a smaller open space not far from the two flying saucers.
As soon as he appeared, he walked directly this way.
Wang Xuan realized that this person was coming for him because his eyes had fallen on him many times and he kept scanning and observing.
Now, this young man directly named him.
"A simple competition, do you dare to have a competition? Old skills versus new skills, do you have confidence? "The young man called Brother Yun asked again.
Wang Xuan looked at his face thoughtfully.
In the past, if someone invited him to fight for no reason, Wang Xuan would probably ignore it and not bother to pay attention.
However, this young man impressed him now. He had mastered the so-called new technique. He wanted to see what kind of path it was!
“New art is also called super art, and some people prefer to call it divine art. "
The very strong man said to himself there, and then added: "The old technique is almost officially eliminated in Xinxing, and now some people are starting to call it a bad technique. "
He waved to Wang Xuan and said: "Do you want to prove it and see if the old technique can still shine with new glory? "
